steps.name: Authenticate registered source and unique run
Prepare pinned host namespace helper
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
sudo apt-get update -qq
sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends bubblewrap meson ninja-build gcc pkg-config libcap-dev
mkdir /tmp/engine-clock-bwrap-source
cd /tmp/engine-clock-bwrap-source
curl --fail --silent --location --proto '=https' --max-time 60 https://github.com/containers/bubblewrap/releases/download/v0.12.0/bubblewrap-0.12.0.tar.xz --output source.tar.xz
printf '%s  %s\n' 9760d007363e3abba7c747489910f9f82d9fca53ba3bd3282e396fa3c97a3314 source.tar.xz | sha256sum --check --status
tar -xf source.tar.xz
meson setup build bubblewrap-0.12.0 -Dtests=false -Dman=disabled -Dselinux=disabled -Dbash_completion=disabled -Dzsh_completion=disabled
ninja -C build
sudo install -m 0755 build/bwrap /usr/bin/bwrap
/usr/bin/bwrap --version
